[← Quantum](../index.qmd)

Study slides for the first course of IBM's *Understanding Quantum Information
and Computation* series, taught by John Watrous. It builds the mathematical
model of quantum information from the ground up: what a quantum state is, how
it is measured and changed, what happens with several systems at once, and what
entanglement can do.

**Prerequisite:** linear algebra with vectors and matrices (complex numbers
included). This course is the prerequisite for [Fundamentals of Quantum
Algorithms](../fundamentals-of-quantum-algorithms/index.qmd). [Original course
page](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/learning/en/courses/basics-of-quantum-information).

## Lectures

::: {.lesson-table .column-page}
| | Lecture | What it covers | Original |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Single systems](lectures/01-single-systems.qmd) | Probabilistic states and stochastic matrices; quantum state vectors, standard basis measurements and unitary operations; Dirac notation | [video](https://youtu.be/3-c4xJa7Flk) · [slides](https://ibm.box.com/public/static/95va6f5vqru3mpsv9p5ivwcyxino4rk7.pdf) |
| 2 | [Multiple systems](lectures/02-multiple-systems.qmd) | Cartesian and tensor products; independence; entangled states (Bell, GHZ, W); partial measurements; swap and controlled operations | [video](https://youtu.be/DfZZS8Spe7U) · [slides](https://ibm.box.com/public/static/86os1t6m7g4ajh36w5x3lo6jcp3j5rrp.pdf) |
| 3 | [Quantum circuits](lectures/03-quantum-circuits.qmd) | Boolean and quantum circuits; inner products and projective measurements; global phases, no-cloning, and discriminating non-orthogonal states | [video](https://youtu.be/30U2DTfIrOU) · [slides](https://ibm.box.com/public/static/zsd4694uko51kzcohdvbp6ncgl9u9ys3.pdf) |
| 4 | [Entanglement in action](lectures/04-entanglement-in-action.qmd) | Quantum teleportation, superdense coding, and the CHSH game | [video](https://youtu.be/GSsElSQgMbU) · [slides](https://ibm.box.com/public/static/9a7pjqxfa2d5uucdlhgid625reuw0b2n.pdf) |
:::

## How to study with these slides

1. Watch the lesson video, or read the original lesson.
2. Go through the deck. Press **S** for speaker notes: they hold the extra
   steps that do not fit on a slide.
3. Redo the calculations on paper, especially the small matrix products. In
   this course the arithmetic *is* the understanding.

The badge exam is linked from the [original course
page](https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/learning/en/courses/basics-of-quantum-information).
